tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅/ /lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa la yan lag bdun pa 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba btab cing yan lag bdun pa bya ba'i sgo nas tshogs gsag par 'dod pas/ gnas khang phyag dar sogs kyis gtsang bar byas pa'i stegs mtho sar bla ma'i sku la sogs pa'i rten rnams bsham/ de'i mdun du mchod pa ci 'byor pa gtsang zhing bkod pa legs pa dang / maṇ+ḍal gcig la tshom bu sum cu so bdun bkod pa'ang bsham/ rnal 'byor pa so so'i mdun du rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa'i rol mo'i yo byad rnams kyang bsham/ de nas thog mar kun rig nas 'byung ba ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa dang / sna tshogs rol mos byin dbab/ skyabs su 'gro ba mang du byas te/ sems bskyed pa lan gsum bya'o/ /de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis spras shing / dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes pa/ sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ gsung gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa/ thugs shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa/ 'od zer bye ba 'gyed pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pas bdag la dges bzhin du bzhugs par bsams la/ de'i mtha' skor du bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dam pa chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pas bskor bar bsams la/ de nas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma brgyud pa/

yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pas bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ dam chos kun 'dus/ dge 'dun kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam mo/ /de la yan lag bdun pa dbul ba la/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /ces pa nas/ khyod mnyes bgyid pa'ang 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar gyis phyag bya/ de nas mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang zhes pa nas/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i bar dang / de nas brgyud pa'i kha skong rtsa ba'i bla ma la thug gi bar dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten zhes pa nas/ bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /ces pa'i bar gyis phyag bya'o/ /gnyis pa mchod pa dbul ba ni/ sngar gyi mchod pa byin brlabs dran pa'i phyir du slar yang lan gcig byas la mchod yon phal cher ma'am/ zhing khams rgya mtsho ma sogs mchod 'bul gyi tshigs bcad gang yang rung ba chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod gdangs dang bcas te rol mo'ang dbul lo/ /de nas grub na rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa'ang bya zhing / de tsam ma grub na'ang rgyal srid sna bdun dang / 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa kun rig ltar bya'o/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma dang / gang gi mchod rdzas ma bya zhing / deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gnyis la tshig rkang gsum pa'i rjes su/ sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir zhes dang / mjug tu bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa sbyar nas/ sa gzhi spos chu byugs shing zhes sogs dang / gu ru bud+dha bodhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye shri ye hūm̐ zhes pas maṇ+ḍal dbul lo/ /yan lag phyi ma lnga ni/ bdag ni thog med dus nas su/ /zhes pa nas ji ltar bsngos pa 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar lan gcig brjod par bya'o/ /de nas 'dun pa rtse gcig pa'i bsam pas phyogs bcu dus gsum ma brjod pa'i sgo nas gsol ba btab la mtha' skor gyi chos skyong srung ma nas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i bar rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/

rtsa ba'i bla ma rang gi spyi bo nas thim ste snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad du gyes pa'i steng du byang sems dkar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du byas pa la bzhugs par bsam nas gdangs dang bcas te thos pa rgya mtsho lan gcig bya'o/ /de nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba'i phyir bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa'i smon lam rgya cher gdab bo/ /gang gi tshe kyai rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pa 'ba' zhig 'tshogs nas gsang sgrogs la sogs pa mi 'byung ba'i gnas dben pa yod pa'i tshe gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra ba las/ mchod pa'i skabs su chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod grangs mang bar bsham/ mchod pa byin dbab pa'ang kyai rdor ltar bya/ mdun du bskyed pa'i tshe seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du bla ma kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum dang bcas par bskyed/ phung khams skye mched lha'i ngo bor bsgom pa lam zab ltar bya/ mjug tu spros pa gcad pa/ dbang blang ba/ lta ba bskyang ba rnams lam zab ltar bya ste/ de nas bla ma spyi bo nas bstims nas thos pa rgya mtsho sogs bya'o/ /lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa la yan lag bdun pa dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa'i tshul 'di ni/ don gnyer gyi slob ma rin chen rgyal mtshan khams la 'gro kha'i nangs par rang du bskul nas/ ja gral de nyid du bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bran du gyur pa mang thos dge slong bsod nams seng ges sbyar ba'o// //dge'o// ༄༅/ /brda dgrol nges pa'i dpal ster bzhugs// ༈ /brda dgrol nges pa'i dpal ster zhes bya ba/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung du gsol/ 'dir rje btsun gyi rgyal po 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas/

stong thun sa bcad kyi mjug tu/ bla med phyogs ni ris bsgyur mig bcas pa/ /rig byed kyis gsal lag pas me la bgos/ /de 'od kun gsal chu gter 'byung bar babs/ /blo ldan don de shes na smra bar gyis/ /legs 'ongs mig gis yon tan gsal bar byas/ /me dang chu bos 'byung ba rab tu bskyed/ /zla bas kun kyang gsal bar byed mod kyi/ /mig gis legs par bltas pas bdag blo dad/ /gzugs gnyis yon tan zung ni thog ma ste/ /gang gis gang ston lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ /gzhung 'dir kun tu bltas pas blo ldan gyis/ /legs rtogs gzhan la ston na bdag blo spro/ /legs 'ongs 'chad pa bshad gzhi lo rgyus can/ /rnam 'grel bcas pa sdig 'joms gzhan min ldan/ /mkhas mtshungs 'dzin bcas dri ma kun spangs te/ /yi ge bzhi ldan nyid du 'gyur bar shog /ces pa'i don 'grel pa la bzhi ste/ spyir rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi brgyud pa smos pa/ bye brag rgyud gsum gyi brgyud pa smos pa/ bshad bya 'chad byed dang bcas pa'i sgo nas don bsdu ba/ 'jug pa po 'bras bu phun sum tshogs par bsngo ba'o/ /dang po ni tshigs su bcad pa dang po ste/ bla med ces pa ni bla med kyi rgyud sde'o/ /phyogs ni bcu yin la/ de ri ste bdun gyis bsgyur bas bdun cur 'gyur/ de mig ste gnyis dang bcas pas bla med kyi rgyud sde bdun cu don gnyis zhes pa'o/ /de gang gis gsal bar byed na/ rig byed ni bzhi ste/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag sogs tshul bzhis gsal bar byed ces pa'o/ /gzhan dag snyan brgyud bzhis zhes 'chad pa ni nor te/ snyan brgyud man ngag gi steng du brtsi bar bya ba yin gyi rgyud kyi steng du brtsi bar bya ba ma yin pa'i phyir dang / stong thun sa bcad kyi don bsdu'i skabs yin pas/ skabs thob kyang ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de gang las brgyud na/ lag pa ni rdo rje 'chang nas brgyud pa gnyis pa bir+wa pa yin la/

des gsum pa me ste sa chen la bgos/ de'i gsung gi 'od zer kun tu gsal ba las bka' babs ni chu gter te bzhi pa rje btsun rtse mo/ 'byung ba ste lnga pa rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la babs zhes pa'o/ /'di brda tshig gis ston dgos te/ gzhan dag yid ma ches nas bsod nams ma yin pa bzlog pa'i ched du gsang bar mdzad pa lo rgyus kyi yi ge na gsal lo/ /de'i shan gyis 'dir ring brgyud kyang brda tshig gis ston pa yin la/ 'jig rten na grags shing yid ches pa'i gnas yin pas dag ljon sogs las gsal bar bshad de 'og tu 'chad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ legs 'ongs zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis te/ legs 'ongs ni yongs su grags pa'i brgyud pa yin la/ mig ni gnyis te/ nag po pa nas brgyud pa dang / ḍom+bi pa nas brgyud pa gnyis so/ /des gang gsal bar byas na/ yon tan ni gsum ste rgyud gsum gsal bar byas pa'o/ /de gang la bka' bab na/ me dang / chu bo dang / 'byung ba ni snga ma'i brda tshig gzhir bzhag nas sa chen dang / rtse mo/ grags pa gsum mo/ /zla ba ni gcig ste/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / des rgyud sde kun kyang gsal bar byed mod kyi 'dir mig ni snga ma ltar brgyud pa gnyis kyis legs par bltas pas bdag gi blo rgyud gsum gyi brjod bya la dad ces pa'o/ /'o na me yan chad kyi brgyud pa gang snyam na/ gzugs gnyis ni nag po pa nas ga ya dha ra'i bar dang / ḍom+bi pa nas dpa' bo rdo rje'i bar gnyis yin la/ yon tan ni gsum ste/ de zung ni brgyud pa dang po 'brog mi/ se ston/ zhang dgon pa ba dang gsum dang / brgyud pa gnyis pa ni 'brog mi/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba shākyaṃ 'bar gsum yin pas de sngar gyi me'i thog mar sbyar zhes pa'o/ /de ltar yang ljon shing las/ de ltar de dag kyang thog mar brgyud pa'i bla ma gnyis las ji ltar brgyud de 'ongs snyam na/

'dir brjod pa/ rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /rje btsun chos skyong mthu stobs dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ /nag po ḍā ma pa dang a wa dhū tī dpal/ /rje btsun ga ya dha ra shākya ye shes mchog /ces bya bas brgyud pa dang po brjod nas/ gzhan yang gnyis pa'ang brjod par bya ste/ gnyis pa ḍom+bi he ru ka dpal de rjes su/ /a la la dang dpal ldan nags khrod gar+bha ri/ /rgyal ba dpal gyi ye shes sbyang dka'i zla ba dang / /dpa' bo rdo rje ye shes zhabs la gdams pa'o/ /brgyud pa gnyis po 'dzin pa'i rje btsun shākya ye shes las/ sus ci ltar thos shing / de dag las kyang bla ma chen pos ji ltar thos snyam na/ dpe dang bstun nas brjod pa/ ma dros ye shes zhabs la rgyun bzhi'i bla ma ni/ /rgyal po rig dang snying po snang ba'i mtha' can te/ /rig dang snying po'i zhabs las 'bar ba 'bar ba'i mtha'/ /rgyun bzhi 'dzin pa'i bla chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes dang / dag ldan las kyang cha 'dra bar 'byung ste/ brgyud pa gnyis las zhes dang / snying po rig las 'bar ba 'bar ba'i mtha'/ /zhes pas/ gzugs gnyis dang yon tan zung bstan cing / de sa chen gyi thog mar sbyar bas lo rgyus ston pa gzhung kun gyi dgongs par snang ngo / /tshul bzhi po gang gis rgyud gsum gang ston pa lo rgyus brgyud pa gnyis po dang bcas pa/ gzhung 'dir zhes sogs ni go sla'o/ /gsum pa ni/ legs 'ongs zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis te/ legs 'ongs ni snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /'chad pa ni bshad thabs kyi man ngag tshul bzhi ste/ 'di la yig cha rgyud sde'i dum bu/ spyi rnams/ ljon shing / stong thun sa bcad dang bzhi yod do/ /bshad gzhi ni rgyud gsum mo/ /lo rgyus can ni sngar gyi brgyud pa gnyis so/ /rnam 'grel ni dag ldan/ gur rgyan/ gnad kyi gsal byed gsum mo/ /bcas pa ni bsdus don gsum mo/ /sdig 'joms ni yab yum gyi bstod pa gnyis te/

bdag med bstod par/ rang bzhin dri med blo gros glo bur gyi/ /dri mas bsgribs pa gsal bar mdzad pa yi/ /zhes gsungs pa las shes so/ /de las gzhan min par ldan pa ni bdag med bstod 'grel te/ dag ldan las/ rgyud spyi la dgos pa'i sdom pa/ rgyud sde'i dum bu rnam gzhag mngon rtogs te/ /stong thun gnyis kyi don bsdus bstod pa gnyis/ /bdag med bstod pa'i rnam 'grel dang bcas pa/ /kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun 'thor mi bya/ /rgyud so so la dgos pa ni/ rgyud don so so'i rnam 'grel don bsdus bcas/ /gang la gang dgos de de blang bya ste/ /de ltar bcu gsum legs par bltas byas nas/ /rnam par phye bas rgyud don shes par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas chos sna bcu gsum po bshad gzhi rgyud gsum dang bcas pa ston pas so/ /bzhi pa ni/ mkhas mtshungs zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis te/ de dag la mkhas pa snga ma dang mtshungs pa nyid du snyan brgyud kyi sgo nas mkhas pa ni rje btsun nyid yin la/ thos bsam gyi sgo nas 'dzin pa dang bcas pa ni slob ma'i tshogs te/ de dag spang bya gnyis kyi dri ma kun spangs te/ thob bya he ru ka zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi'i don dang ldan par shog ces pa'o/ /'di'i tshigs bcad dang po 'grel pa du ma snang zhing / phyi ma rnams dgrol ba mthong zhing thos pa med pas spobs pa zhum par gyur pa'i tshe/ skyes chen dam pa dag gis dris pa'i rkyen byas nas rna ro'i ban+de gshin rje grags kyis bzhengs pa'i rje btsun gyi sku 'dra'i drung du gsol ba btab pas/ rtog pa la rang dgar shar ba rgyud gsum smra ba'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges bris pa'o// //'di dag don du ma song na/ /sems kyi dri mar gyur pa la/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni smod mi mdzad/ /ces pa'i tshul gyis bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzad nas/ thugs rjes gzung du gsol/ don du song na dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can thams cad kyis sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du bsngo'o/

/dge'o// ༄༅/ /rgyud kyi tshig don la dogs gcod bzhugs// ༈ /bla ma dang dpal kyai rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi phyi ma'i dgu par/ dang po rnam snang der rjes su/ /rdo rje ma yi mtha' ru hūm̐/ /zhes pa'i 'grel pa mu tig phreng ba las/ der rjes rdo rje zhes pa ni yi ge a ste/ 'dir de nyid drag cing du'o/ /zhes dang / gzhung 'ga' zhig las/ drag ring du'o zhes pa'ang snang ngo / /bha ba bha dra'i 'grel pa las/ der rjes rdo rje ma ni dbyangs yig gnyis pa ste/ de la thig le gnyis sbyar ba'o/ /de nas yang hūm̐ yi ge a yig gi pha rol du thig le gnyis ni phyis pa'o/ /des na rdo rje hūm̐ zhes pa ni mtha'i drag po'i thig le dag thim zhing sbas pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /dka' 'grel pad+ma can las/ rdo rje ma ni a'o zhes bshad do/ /ḍhaṃ ka da sha'i 'grel pa las/ dang por rnam snang zhes pa ste thog mar oṃ yig go /de'i rjes su rdo rje ma a yig ste ā dang 'dus pa las ā'o/ /mtha' ru hūm̐ zhes pa rdo rje gsum gyi yi ge oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa ste zhes bshad do/ /de dag gi nang nas dka' 'grel pad+ma can gyis a thung la ngos 'dzin par bshad snang zhing / mu tig phreng bar drag cing du'o zhes pa ltar na a thung dang / drag ring du'o zhes pa ltar na ā ring la ngos 'dzin pa 'dra'o/ /bha ba bha dra dang / ḍhaṃ ka da sha gnyis kyis ni dbyangs kyi gnyis pa la ngos 'dzin par snang ste/ phyag gnyis pa'i sngags btu'i skabs su/ rdo rje ma yis rnam par brgyan/ /zhes pa dbyangs yig gnyis pa yin pa dang khyad med snyam du sems so/ /'khrul pa zad pa'i grub chen mi thub zla ba'i zhal nas rnam snang ni oṃ ste/ de dang por ro/ /rdo rje ma ni a'o/ /dbyangs kyi mtha' zhes bya ba ni a ste de dang ldan pa'o/ /mthar hūm̐ ni bza' ba dang / btung ba byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags so zhes gsungs te/

'di'i don/ rdo rje ma ā li gnyis pa rdo rje ma zhes pa ltar dbyangs yig gnyis pa la ngos 'dzin pa yang de'i ya mtha' ni dbyangs yig dang po yin zhes pa'am/ yang rdo rje ma yang yin dbyangs kyi mtha' yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun ltar na rdo rje ma ni zhe sdang zhes pa ltar gtso mo bdag med ma la 'jug pas gang ltar yang a thung kho na la ngos 'dzin par mdzad do/ /des na dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ 'bru gsum aḥl tsheg drag thob/ /nga ro ring char bklags pas nor/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang skyon med par grub bo/ /le'u brgyad pa'i grub mtha' bzhi'i 'grel par/ shān+ti pa'i mu tig phreng ba las 'dod chags dang bral bar smra ba'i bye brag smra ba ste/ de lta bu de nyid ni bye brag tu smra ba'o/ /de nyid ni nyan thos kyi theg pa ste/ gdams ngag brgya pa dang / spel ma gsum pa'i phreng ba la sogs pa'i lung ngo / /mdo sde zhes pa ni theg pa chen po'i mdo sde shin tu zab pa ma yin pa rnams te/ de'ang tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa zhes bya ba dang / tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs zhes bya ba dang / sgo drug pa zhes bya ba dang / bzang po spyod pa dang / chos bzhi pa dang / rgya cher rol pa dang / sa bcu'i mdo la sogs pa rnams so/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa zhes pa ni sna tshogs pa 'di dag ni sems tsam ste don du snang ba rnams ni bden pa ma yin zhing sems nyid bag chags kyi stobs las de lta bur skye ba ni rmi lam ji lta ba bzhin no zhes so/ /dbu ma zhes pa la dbu ma ni lam ste/ de yang sems gnyis kyi rang bzhin gyis yod pa ma yin zhing / gnyis pos stong pa'i rang bzhin gyis med pa ma yin zhes pa'i don to/ /bstan zhes pa ni rim gyis de ltar bstan par bya'o/ /rgyud kun gyi zhes pa la sogs pa ni de'i rjes su 'di zhes bya bar sbyar ro zhes bshad pa ni rang nyid gnyis stong gi shes pa bden par grub pa dbu ma'i lugs su byas nas sems tsam pa logs su ngos 'dzin pa'i lugs su snang ngo /

/dka' 'grel pad+ma can las/ bye brag smra ba de la bstan/ /zhes pa phung po lnga la sogs pa'i rang bzhin bstan pa'o/ /mdo sde pa zhes pa ni theg pa chen po'i mdo'o/ /rnal 'byor pa zhes pa thams cad rnam par shes pa'o/ /dbu ma pa zhes pa yod pa dang med pa zhes pa la sogs pa'i phyogs stong pa nyid do/ /thams cad sngags kyi tshul zhes bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor bla ma'i tshul du'o/ /de ltar na gal te bzung na phan yon ni blangs pas slob ma de'i tshe 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes dang / dka' 'grel rin po che'i sbyor phreng las bye brag smra ba zhes pa ni 'dod chags dang bral ba'i phyir bshad pa ste/ de'ang nyan thos kyi theg pa gdams ngag brgya pa dang / rgyun chags gsum pa'i phreng ba la sogs pa'o/ /mdo sde zhes bya ba ni mdo rgyas pa dag ste/ tshigs bcad gcig pa dang / gnyis pa dang / bzhi pa dang / sgo drug pa'i gzungs dang / bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam dang / rgya cher rol pa dang / sa bcu pa la sogs pa'o/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa zhes bya ba ni sna tshogs 'di dag sems tsam ste/ rmi lam ltar 'khrul pa'i dbang gis brdzun pa dag gcig kho nar snang gi kho na nyid du ni ma yin no/ /dbu ma zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad kyi skye ba med pa nyid do zhes dang / ḍhaṃ ka da sha'i 'grel pa las/ de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /zhes pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi tshul te/ nyan thos rnams kyi byang chub ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa spangs pa'i rang bzhin no/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni shes bya'i sgrib pa'i phyogs gcig spangs pa'i rang bzhin no/ /mdo sde zhes pa mdo sde klog par byed pa'o/ /rnal 'byor spyad pa zhes pa rnam par shes pa tsam bden zhes pa rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lugs so/ /dbu ma zhes pa mtha' bzhi las rnam par grol ba kun rdzob thams cad ces pa dbu ma pa'i lugs so zhes gsungs pa rnams ni grub mtha' bzhi'i lta ba'i rim pa ji lta ba bzhin 'grel pa'i lugs su snang ste/

'jam dpal gyi zhal lung dang / ye shes snying po kun las btus gnyis las gsungs pa'i grub mtha' bzhi'i lta ba'i rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du snang ngo / /'di yang rgyud kyi tshig don la/ /sgro 'dogs gcod par 'dod pa yi/ /don du bsod nams seng ges sbyar/ /dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo/ /dge'o// ༄༅/ /saṃ bu ṭi'i bsdus don tshigs bcad ma bzhugs// ༈ /na mo gu ru bha drā ya/ thabs dang shes rab yang dag sbyor/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dri ma 'khrud/ /dri bral rdo rje sems dpa' dpal/ /rgyud gsum dbyer med la btud nas/ /bla med rgyud sde thams cad kyi/ /gleng gzhi gsang ba yang dag sbyor/ /las byung dpal ldan rgyud rgyal gyi/ /spyi don rnam lngas rtogs bya ste/ /rgyud sde spyi yi rnam gzhag dang / /mtshan don bshad thabs man ngag dang / /rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa dang / /gnas lugs ji ltar gnas pa'o/ /dang po bzhi po gzhan du gsal/ /lnga pa gnas lugs la gnyis te/ /brtag pa gang nas gang byung dang / /mngon rtogs bsdebs te brjod pa'o/ /dang po gleng gzhis mdor bstan nas/ /mtshan gyi don gyis cung zad bshad/ /brtag pa dang pos rgyas par bshad/ /brtag pa phyi ma dgu yis ni/ /de don rab tu rgyas par bshad/ /phyi ma'i rgyud kyis tshig dang ni/ /don rnams so sor phye ba ste/ /mdor bstan rgyas bshad rim pa lnga/ /gleng gzhi gdams ngag drug gis ni/ /bshad pas rgyud don ma lus bstan/ /mtshan don nyid kyis gleng gzhi'i don/ /rgyud gsum nyid du 'dus par bstan/ /brtag pa dang po'i dang po las/ /don dam byang sems sngon 'gro ba'i/ /kun rdzob byang sems kyis bsdus pa/ /de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa dang / /don dam byang sems de nyid kyang / /bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis skye ba yis/ /rang rig bdag nyid dag pa ste/ /'jug bya gnyis po rim bzhin bstan/ /de la thos bsam las byung dang /

/bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis 'jug pa ste/ /'jug tshul gnyis po rim bzhin du/ /rab byed gnyis pas bstan pa yin/ /gsum pas rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyi/ /gleng gzhis 'bras rgyud gtso bor bstan/ /bzhi pas pha rgyud gleng gzhi yis/ /thabs dang 'bras rgyud gtso bor bstan/ /mdor na brjod bya rnam gnyis dang / /rjod byed rnam gnyis bsdus pa'i phyir/ /brtag pa dang po'i rab byed bzhi/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi mdor bstan yin/ /lhag ma mngon par rtogs pa ni/ /skye ba'i rim bzhin gnas pa ste/ /byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur ba'i/ /rten gyi dkyil 'khor rnam gzhag dang / /slob dpon bdag 'jug cho ga'i rim/ /dbang rten rig ma mtshan nyid bcas/ /mchod cing gsol gdab dkyil 'khor mchod/ /mchog dbang bskur tshul dam tshig bcas/ /bdun gyis brtag pa gnyis pa yi/ /rab byed dang po bsdus pa yin/ /gnyis pas dbang thob brtan phyir du/ /bsam gyis mi khyab don bsgom dang / /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs bsgoms pas/ /thabs dang shes rab don bsgom bstan/ /de nas rab tu byed pa ni/ /drug gis bskyed pa'i rim pa ste/ /bskyed rim spyi yi rnam gzhag dang / /he ru ka gsum sgrub pa'i thabs/ /spyi dang so so'i bye brag gis/ /rab tu byed pa gsum pa bsdus/ /sgrol ma ku ru kul+le dang / /pha rol phyin dang rigs bzhi dang / /yum bzhi las rgyas rnal 'byor ni/ /bcu gcig gis ni bzhi pa bsdus/ /gsum pa'i dang pos kyai rdo rje/ /bcu bdun lha yi bdag nyid dang / /gnyis pas ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /lha mo bcu gsum dkyil 'khor dang / /gsum pas bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang / /bzhi pas dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /drag po'i gdan can lha bcu bdun/ /dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa bstan/ /de nas rab tu byed pa lngas/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i spyod pa dang /

/brtul zhugs spyod pa'i grogs dang gnas/ /dus la sogs pa shes phyir du/ /bzhi pa'i dang pos ngag brda dang / /gnyis pas mkha' 'gro ma bdun gyi/ /mtshan nyid bstan cing gsum pa yis/ /lā ma rigs lngar phye ba dang / /de la phyag rgya bsten tshul bstan/ /bzhi pas lus brda lnga pa yi/ /dang pos phyi nang mthar thug pa'i/ /'du ba'i gnas dang dus sogs bstan/ /gnyis pas rdzogs rim mnyam gzhag dang / /rjes spyod dag pa gsum gsum bstan/ /phyi ma gnyis kyis drod thob nas/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa spyad pa'i tshul/ /ston te gsum pas gsang spyod ni/ /gtsor gyur spyod pa'i mtshan nyid bstan/ /bzhi pas spyod pa'i rab dbye ba/ /sgrub pa'i rim pa dang bcas bstan/ /brtag pa drug pas nye rgyu'am/ /rdzogs rim mtha' dag rgyas bshad de/ /gnyis ka lus la brten pas na/ /lus nyid gtan la 'bebs phyir ro/ /de yang drug pa mtha' dag gis/ /mdor bstan lus 'grub gnas pa'i rgyu/ /byang chub sems dang de dag kyang / /rtsa sgo gnyis la brten nas ni/ /lus 'grub tshul dang de dag la/ /mngon du byed pa'i rlung dang ni/ /dpyid kyi thig le thabs dang bcas/ /yul gyi dgos pas dang po bsdus/ /rtsa gnyis dpyid dang thig ler bstan/ /sgo rnams gsum la brten pa'i rlung / /'khor lo bzhi yi gnas lugs lus/ /sum cu rtsa bdun rtsa rnams kyi/ /gnas dang las la sogs pa yi/ /rab byed gnyis pa bsdus pa yin/ /rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs la/ /phyi rol chos rnams bsdu phyir du/ /rab byed lhag ma gnyis gsungs te/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dang / /mchod dang bzlas dang sku gsum gyi/ /rnam dag nyid ni gsum pas bstan/ /sdom pa'i rab tu dbye ba dang / /sems can rang bzhin sangs rgyas kyang / /glo bur dri ma sel ba yi/ /thabs ni 'thad pa dang bcas dang / /dpyid thig mngon du byed pa'i thabs/ /rab byed bzhi pas bstan pa yin/

/de nas brtag pa bdun pa dang / /brgyad pa dgu pa'i phyi ma gsum/ /bcu pa'i tha ma rnams kyis ni/ /dngos grub mtha' dag sgrub thabs bstan/ /de la ngag brda'i ye shes dang / /lta stangs sgo nas las sgrub dang / /rnam shes dang ni ye shes kyi/ /las ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / /dbang du byed pa'i las brgyad dang / /mi snang ye shes bcu gnyis dang / /grub pa'i mig sman ye shes dang / /bcud kyi len gyi ye shes dang / /bdun gyis bsdus pa'i dang po bsdus/ /bsnyen pa dang ni sa chog la/ /rkang stabs bkod pa sngon song bas/ /sbyin sreg cho ga gnyis pas bstan/ /sngags btu ba dang 'khrul 'khor la/ /brten pa'i las kyis gsum pa bsdus/ /thog mar sa yongs gzung ba dang / /sa slong ba dang dkyil 'khor sgrub/ /sbyin sreg las ni sngon song bas/ /rab gnas bya bar bstan pa'i phyir/ /sbyin sreg cho ga rgyas pa dang / /lha yi rnal 'byor nyer gcig la/ /brten pa'i bsam gtan gyi ni las/ /nyer rgyu sgrub thabs bzhi pas bstan/ /de nyid bzhi zhus mnyan par gdams/ /rdo rje dril bu'i mtshan nyid dang / /de nyid gzung thabs dang bcas pas/ /brgyad pa'i dang po bsdus pa yin/ /bgrang phreng de nyid gnyis pas bstan/ /'pho ba'i rnal 'byor grong 'jug bcas/ /ye shes de nyid gsum pas bstan/ /bzhi pas sngags rnams bstan pa'o/ /dgu pa'i dang pos spyod pa'i mthar/ /nyer rgyu 'bras bu 'grub pa'i gnas/ /'bras bu nyid dang thabs gang gis/ /mngon du byed pa gsum gyis bstan/ /gnyis pas phyi yi dkyil 'khor dang / /bdag gis rnal 'byor rdzas byin brlabs/ /mchod pa'i dus dang mgron spyan drangs/ /gtor ma dbul dang byin rlabs sngags/ /rtog pa med par bka' bsgol na/ /bkra shis smon lam gdab pa dang / /gshegs su gsol ba'i bya ba ste/ /bcu yis gtor ma'i cho ga bstan/ /bris sku dang ni glegs bam gyi/ /bri ba'i gzhi dang gang zag dang /

/tshul ni ji ltar bri ba dang / /bcang ba'i tshul gyis gsum pa bsdus/ /bzhi pas rol mo'i bya ba dang / /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i tshul ston te/ /rol mo'i sgra skad rnga yi tshul/ /rnga yi bya ba sgo ba la/ /gsol gdab tshogs kyis phan yon dang / /gang du bya dang yo byad dang / /glu gar tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /dam tshig sbyin pa'i tshul bcu bstan/ /bcu pa'i dang po gsum gyis ni/ /mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig gi /mjug bsdu dang ni sgrub pa'i mthar/ /nyer rgyu'i rten ni gang zhig la/ /brten te 'bras bu 'grub pa bstan/ /de la thabs rgyud bsdus pa dang / /nyer rgyu'i rten gyis dang po bsdus/ /'bras bu 'grub pa'i dus kyis ni/ /ngo mtshar ltas ni gnyis pas bstan/ /phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub kyi/ /'bras bu sku gnyis bdag nyid can/ /rab byed gsum pas bstan pa yin/ /bzhi pas sngar gyi sbyin sreg la/ /rtsod pa spong dang tshul gzhan yang / /dam tshig sdom pa'i sgo nas kyang / /'bras bu 'grub par bstan pa 'o/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud du mi gsal bar/ /gsal dang ma tshang kha bskang phyir/ /bcu gcig pa ni phyi ma'i rgyud/ /de ltar mdo rgyas rim lngar gnas/ /mngon rtogs bsdebs te brjod pa ni/ /rags pa'i rim pa gzhung la gnas/ /zhib tu phye na 'khrugs bsdebs te/ /rgyu rgyud sems can gnas lugs dang / /thabs la smin grol rnam pa gnyis/ /lam la mngon rtogs bcu gcig dang / /'bras bu sku yi rnam gzhag sogs/ /bla ma'i zhal las blang bar bya/ /grags pa rgyal mtshan gsung gi rgyud rgyal gzhan/ /bsdus don tshar du mngar ba'i phreng mthong nas/ /bsod nams rtse mo'i legs bshad rin chen phreng / /bsod nams seṅges tshig gi srad bur brgyus/ /'khrul med gong ma'i gsung gi rjes 'brangs nas/ /blo gros bsgrims te tshig tsam bsgrigs pa'i phyir/ /nyes pa med cing dge tshogs gang thob des/ /tshe rabs kun tu chos tshul 'di thos shog

/dge'o// // ༄༅/ /gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du bkri ba'i lam spyi'i rnam gzhag bzhugs// ༈ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i tshig rkang la lam rgyas 'bring gsum du bstan pa dang / lam zab 'bring gsum du bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ lam dang 'bras bu gnyis/ lam la lam rgyas pa chos bco brgyad kyis bsdus pa las/ 'khor 'das thun mong gi gzhung tshom bu bdun/ 'khor lo 'cham pa 'jig rten pa'i lam la gzhung tshom bu bdun te bcu bzhi po gang zag gcig gi nyams len/ lam rgyas pa'i khrid tshul ltar sbyar na lam gyi gzhi bca' ba/ lam rang gi ngo bo/ lam gyi spros pa gcod byed/ lam gyi sa mtshams rnam par gzhag pa/ lam gyi bogs dbyung ba/ lam gyi gegs sel ba dang rnam pa drug tu 'dus pa las/ dang po ni snang ba gsum du bstan pa'i lam mo/ /gnyis pa ni rgyud gsum du bstan pa'i lam ste/ 'di la rgyu rgyud/ thabs rgyud/ 'bras rgyud gsum las/ dang po ni bsgom bya 'khor 'das dbyer med dang po nas yod pas skabs 'dir bstan kyang de bsgom pa la tshul gnyis las/ rdo rje theg pas thun mong ma yin pa'i bsgom tshul dbang gong ma'i lta ba dang sbyar nas bsgom dgos pas nyams len ni dbang gi rjes la 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa thabs rgyud la thabs rgyud kyi thog ma rgyu'i dbang / lam la sogs pa'i chos nyi shu/ dam tshig gi tshogs bstan pa/ thabs rgyud kyi gtso bo lam dus kyi dbang dang bzhi las/ dang po ni smin byed kyi dbang ngo / /gzhung las dam tshig 'og tu gsungs kyang / lus so sor btags pa'i 'gog pa la dbang gi rjes su dam tshig de nas lam sogs nyi shu 'byung / 'bring gi lam la ni dbang gi rjes su lam gyi ngo bo dam tshig nyi shu'o/ /thabs rgyud kyi gtso bo lam dus kyi dbang ni lam sogs nyi shu brtson pas nyams su len pa ma byung na yang rgyu dus kyi rjes su lam dus kyi dbang bzhi po thun bzhir bsgoms pa kho nas lam thams cad bgrod nas 'bras bu la mtshams sbyar ba ste/

thabs rgyud kyi gtso bor 'jog pa'i gnad kyang 'di nyid yin no/ /gsum pa 'bras bu'i rgyud 'dir bstan pa ni nye rgyu 'bras dus kyi dbang nas 'bras bu thob ces rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel pa'i sgo nas bstan pa yin la/ 'og tu che ba gsum ldan gyi sgo nas bstan pa ni 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa lam gyi spros pa gcod byed ni tshad ma bzhi dang snyan brgyud bzhi ste/ man ngag gi spros pa thams cad 'di gnyis kyi sgo nas bcad pas lam la nges shes khyad par can skyes te bogs dbyung ba'o/ /rje btsun gyi khrid kyi gzhung shing las/ ting nge 'dzin ngo shes par bya zhing nges shes khyad par can bskyed la zhes gsungs pa'i nges shes bskyed tshul ni 'di gnyis la gsungs so/ /bzhi pa lam gyi sa mtshams rnam par gzhag pa ni rten 'brel lngar bstan pa'i lam ste/ phyi nang gsang bas rten 'brel gsum gyis 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi sa mtshams rnam par gzhag de kho na nyid dang mthar thug rten 'brel gnyis kyis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyi sa mtshams rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /lnga pa lam gyi bogs dbyung ba ni sa chen gyis 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi gzhung tshom bu bdun po thams cad kyi don shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i man ngag bdun du bsdus nas bstan pa ste/ glegs bam dkar chag tu rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos su gsungs pa dang don gcig go /bdun pa so so'i dgos pa ni/ 'du lugs gsum dang phyogs med bdun dag gis/ /rnam par phye bas sgro skur bral bar mdzod/ /ces sogs kyis ston te 'dir ma bris so/ /drug pa lam gyi gegs sel ba la srung ba sum cu'i skabs su bstan pa'i gegs sel/ gdams ngag drug gi skabs su bstan pa'i gegs sel/ man ngag gi gnad bdun cu'i skabs su bstan pa'i gegs sel/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lam gyi gegs sel dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rten gyi gang zag thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba/

shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba/ zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor pa gsum las/ phyi ma la bar chad mi 'byung bas dang po gnyis la bar chad bzhi bzhi la srung ba brgyad brgyad de bcu drug dang / thun mong gi srung ba bcu bzhi ste sum cu'o/ /gnyis pa ni bsgom bya lta ba dang bsam gtan gnyis la dug dbyung / bdud rtsi bsten/ la dor ba gsum gsum ste/ dug dbyung ba ni nyams myong ma skyes pa bskyed par byed pa/ bdud rtsi bsten pa ni skyes pa bogs dbyung ba/ la dor ba ni skyon byung ba sel ba yin kyang gegs sel gtso che bas sa chen gyis gegs sel du bsdus so/ /'di gnyis ni 'khor 'das thun mong gi lam gyi skabs su 'byung ngo / /gsum pa ni bsal bya rtsa zug rlung zug rlung rengs gsum la sel byed dang po la la dor/ gnyis pa la rngan dgas byin pa/ gsum pa la la dor/ byin gyis brlab/ bde ba bsgom pa gsum du phye nas bstan pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ gnas skabs thig le 'bar ba dang / g.yo ba dang / brtan pa gsum las dang po 'bar ba'i tshe thig le'i zug 'byung ste de la kha sbyar brtan par gyur nas dud 'gro'i 'gyur pa bzhi yis bzlog pas lus la thig le g.yo ba med par bya ste/ des g.yo ba'i gegs kyang sel lo/ /lus la gtun shing gi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / yan lag bzhis rlung gi zhags pa 'phang ba dang / bu chung gi spyod lam gsum gyis thig le brtan par 'gyur ba'o/ /gegs sel mdor bsdu na skyon yon tan du slong ba dang / bar chad dngos grub tu len pa dang / gang yang nyams kyi snang bar mkhyen pa gsum mo/ /gzhung gi lam rgyas pa'i khrid tshul yongs su rdzogs pa ni ji skad bshad pa 'di dag yin la/ 'di ci lta ba bzhin du bkri bas gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du bkri ba'i gzhung shing zhes pa'i sgra don yang grub bo/ /de ltar 'jig rten pa'i lam du 'di dag brtson pa drag pos bsgoms pas/

khams 'dus pa gsum mthar phyin te grub mtha' snyogs par 'gyur la/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam bzhi po rgyal ba sku bzhis so sor ston par 'gyur ro/ /'di yang gnad kyi don rnams la/ rang nyid brjed pa spong ba'i phyir/ /blo ldan bsod nams seṅges sbyar/ /dge bas rdo rje 'chang thob shog /dge'o// ༄༅/ /mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul la drang nges phye ba bzhugs// ༈ /yon tan kun 'dzin bla ma rdo rje 'dzin/ /dga' bde'i dpal 'dzin mkhyen pas de nyid 'dzin/ /bzang po'i spyod 'dzin thugs rjes gdul bya 'dzin/ /dge legs kun 'dzin bla mas rjes 'dzin mdzod/ /'dir mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul ni/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud las/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di dper na til gyi gong bu bzhin du yongs su gang bar gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba byang chub pa'i snying por zhugs pa gang na ba der gshegs te/ byang chub sems dpa' de la ched du longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bstan nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis gang gi phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid mngon par ma rtogs par dka' ba spyad pa thams cad la spro ba bskyed cing ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par bya snyam/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po don thams cad grub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bskul bas mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de kho na nyid ni ji lta bu lags/ ji ltar na bsgrub par bgyi bka' stsal par gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang /

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsung gcig tu 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu rang gi sems la so sor rtog cing mnyam par zhog la rang bzhin gyi grub pa'i sngags 'di ci dgar zlos shing bsgrub par gyis shig om̐ tsit+ta pra ti zhes sogs mngon par byang chub pa lnga gsungs so/ /de'i 'grel par/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis ko sa la'i rgyan las/ bcom ldan 'das don thams cad grub pa shākya'i rigs su skye ba yongs su bzhes nas/ gzhon nu'i rol pa dang / bzo bstan pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor na bzhugs pa dang / mngon par byung ba dang / rab tu byung ba'ang bstan nas sems can sngon yongs su smin par byas pa mir skye ba rnams dang sku tshe yang dag par 'brel ba la sogs pas don mdzad pa'i phyir dang / mu stegs kyi lta ba mngon par zhen cing dka' bar spyod pas grol bar 'gyur ro zhes mngon par rlom pa rnams la mngon pa'i nga rgyal gzhom pa'i phyir dka' bar spyod pa mdzad par yang bstan te/ dka' ba spyod pa'i sa nyid la byin gyis rlabs kyis mi'i lus bzhag nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis lha'i rgyal po'i gnas su gshegs te/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin lta bu la snyoms par zhugs nas 'og min gyi gnas na bzhugs pa gang na ba der gshegs pa ste/ der bzhud ces bya ba'i don to zhes dang / gal te mngon par byang chub pa gzhan gyi man ngag la ltos dgos na/ de lta na ni bcom ldan 'das bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs pas slob dpon med pa'i ye shes su ji ltar gzhag ce na/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pa bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa ni rgyu'i gnas skabs yongs su rdzogs pa yin gyi/

de'i 'bras bu'i gnas skabs yongs su rdzogs pa ma yin te/ de'i phyir lung nod pa gzung ba rigs pa nyid yin la/ gang gi tshe 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i mi rnams kyi don rdzogs par mdzad pa'i phyir mngon par byang chub par ston pa de'i tshe slob dpon med pa'i ye shes can du gzhag pa yin no zhes bshad do/ /grub chen kun dga' snying pos de nyid snang ba las/ byang chub dgongs shing sems dpa'i thugs 'di la mnga' bas na byang chub sems dpa'o/ /sems can gyi tshogs chen po'i don chen po mdzad pa la rab tu 'jug pas na sems dpa' chen po'o/ /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs pas don thams cad 'grub par bya ba bzhed pa tsam la rag las pa 'di la mnga' bas na don thams cad grub pa'o/ /byang chub kyi rgyu'i snying po ni byang chub kyi snying po ste/ mar gyi snying po dang 'dra bar gnas kyi snying por gyur pa'o/ /der bzhugs pa ni nye bar gnas par mdzad pa'o/ /gang na ba der zhes bya ba ni rgyu'i gsum pa'o/ /de'i don ni 'di yin te/ gang gis bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du skye ba sna tshogs bzhes te/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par mdzad nas/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bskyed de/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i chen po'i yang chen po bskyed nas ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus can gyi srid pa tha ma par mdzad nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad las dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i rgyur 'tshang rgya bar bya'o zhes dgongs nas/ dbugs rngub pa dang dbugs 'byung ba bkag ste/ bcom ldan 'das don thams cad grub pa 'og min gyi gnas byang chub kyi snying po na bzhugs pa gang na ba der gshegs shing bzhugs nas 'di skad gsungs pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas shākya'i rigs su skye ba ston par mdzad do zhes gsungs pas na shākya'i rigs su skye ba bzhes nas zhes bya ba 'di de la mi rigs so zhes bshad do/

/slob dpon ār+ya de bas mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa las/ mngon par byang chub rnam gnyis te/ /phyi dang nang gi zhes su bshad/ /phyi ni mdo sde rnal 'byor rgyud/ /thub pa mi g.yo ba la bzhugs/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis 'di skad bskul/ /'dis ni mthar thug mi 'thob ste/ /nam mkha'i dkyil ltar mchog gyur pa/ /'od gsal ba yi gnas thob nas/ /rang dga'i bzhugs gnas bha gar gsungs/ /de ltar thams cad stong bsgoms pas/ /byang chub snying por mngon sangs rgyas/ /byang chub sems dpa' don grub la/ /rigs bzhi'i bde bar gshegs pa yis/ /mngon par byang chub lnga bstan pas/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' des/ /mngon par byang chub lnga bsgoms pas/ /byang chub snying por mngon sangs rgyas/ /rnam snang mdzad dang rdor dbyings su/ /mngon par sangs rgyas phyi yi tshul/ /nang ni gsang sngags nang tshul te/ /skye bo 'dod chags can don du/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs te/ /nyid kyis 'khor bsdus gzugs sprul te/ /bde ba'i snang ba rnam pa gsum/ /zil gnon 'od gsal mi rtog las/ /bha ga byin brlabs gzhal yas bskyed/ /sngags kyi bdag por byin brlabs te/ /zhal gsum lta bur dbus su bzhugs/ /chos bshad 'khor rnams rim byung ba/ /de ni nang gi byang chub bo/ /yang na nang gi phyi nyid ni/ /phyag rgya mo la rab brten te/ /snang gsum rim myong las 'das pa'i/ /thams cad stong pa 'od gsal ba/ /bla ma'i man ngag las rnyed pas/ /de ni nang gi phyi zhes bshad/ /nang gi nang ni phyag rgya bral/ /dang po smig rgyu 'od lnga'i tshul/ /bde ba rtog bral nyams myong gsum/ /gsum po las 'das gsum po nyid/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i rang bzhin dag /bla ma'i man ngag las rnyed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rim pa gnyis pa shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i skabs las/ sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang zhing / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur ldan/

/rnam pa kun gyis mchog ldan pa'i/ /thams cad mkhyen par de nas 'gyur/ /de skad du rgya cher rol pa'i mdo las/ shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs/ /mngon par byang chub 'dir bzhed nas/ /stong pa chen po sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob par bya zhes mngon par dgongs/ /nai rāñja ra'i chu 'gram du/ /mi g.yo'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs/ /de tshe rgyal bas mkha' rdo rje/ /til gyi gong bu gang bzhin bzhugs/ /rgyal ba'i sras la se gol dang / /de la dbyangs gcig gis gsungs pa/ /bsam gtan 'di yis rnam dag min/ /'dis ni mthar thug mi 'thob ste/ /nam mkha'i ngos ltar mchog gyur pa/ /'od gsal ba ni de dmigs shig /'od gsal ba yi gnas thob nas/ /rang dga'i gzugs su skye bar 'gyur/ /de tshe rab dga' rdo rje'i sku/ /kun gyi dbang phyug 'thob par 'gyur/ /'di ltar sgra de gsan pa dang / /de nas ting 'dzin mi g.yo btang / /'di ltar nam phyed dus su ni/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis de nyid dmigs/ /sku ni drang po ma yin cing / /mi drang ba yang ma yin la/ /dbugs gtong ba dang rngub pa min/ /gsungs pa ma yin mi gsung min/ /spyan bzang btsums pa ma yin zhing / /spyan phye ba yang ma yin pas/ /thams cad stong pa rmad chen po/ /dwangs shing gsal ba'i ye shes che/ /bla ma nyid kyi drin gyis ni/ /de nas de nyid gsal mthong gyur/ /'das pa dang ni ma 'ongs dang / /da ltar byung ba'i srid pa gsum/ /skad cig de la ma lus mthong / /'od gsal ba ni rnam dag 'chang / /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /skya rengs 'char ka'i dus su ni/ /chu zla dang ni smig rgyu sogs/ /sgyu ma'i yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /byang chub snying por bzhugs nas ni/ /des ni bdud rnams bcom par mdzad/ /shākya'i mgon pos yang dag pa'i/ /ye shes bla med legs thob nas/ /'gro ba bskyab cing phan pa'i phyir/ /de nyid 'dir ni ston par mdzad/ /mngon par byang chub ston pa ni/

/de nyid ye shes zhes byar bshad/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis grol ba'i thig le las/ ci phyir shākya thub pa yis/ /grangs med bar du tshogs bsags kyang / /'di don ma rtogs nai rāñjar/ /ci yang ma yin ting 'dzin gnas/ /de tshe bde gshegs kun gyis kyang / /thal byung blo can de bzlog ste/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ltar rnam dag pa'i/ /zab gsal gnyis med rab bstan te/ /nam phyed dus su brgyal ba ltar/ /de nyid bsgoms pas tho rangs su/ /skad cig gis ni yang dag rtogs/ /byang chub snying por bzhugs nas kyang / /dpung chen bdud rnams rab bcom ste/ /sems can gzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba 'o/ /de nas bzung ste don mchog 'di/ /skal ba ldan pa 'ga' zhig la/ /zhal nas zhal dang snyan nas snyan/ /brgyud de nges pa'i don bstan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / sman pa'i zhabs la sogs pa rjes 'brang dag gis kyang 'di lung du drangs nas 'di bzhin du bshad do/ /da ni de dag gi don bshad par bya ste/ de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud las/ byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pa dka' ba spyad pa'i tshe sangs rgyas thams cad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bstan nas mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin las bslangs te/ mngon par byang chub pa lnga bstan pas sangs rgya bar dngos su gsungs pa la/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis/ de nyid nges pa'i don nyid du 'chad de/ rnam smin gyis lus nai rāñja ra'i 'gram du bzhag nas/ yid kyi lus 'og min du gshegs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mngon byang lnga bstan pas sangs rgya bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'di'ang drang ba'i don du bshad du rung ngo snyam na/ de ni ma yin te/ 'grel pa'i tshig 'og mas mngon par byang chub pa gzhan gyi man ngag la ltos dgos pa'i shes byed du byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pas rgyu'i gnas skabs kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa yin gyi/

'bras bu'i gnas skabs ma rdzogs pas gzhan gyi man ngag la ltos dgos pa'i phyir dang / gzhan gyi gdams ngag la mi ltos pa ni/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rnams kyi ngor tshul ston pa tsam yin par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /grub chen kun dga' snying pos byang chub la dgongs shing sems dpa'i thugs 'di la mnga' bas na byang chub sems dpa'o zhes pa nas/ 'di skad gsungs pa yin no zhes pa'i bar gyis sngar gyi shākya bshes gnyen gyi bzhed pa de nyid phyogs sngar bkod nas/ bcom ldan 'das bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas zhes pa man chad kyis gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i lung drangs nas de dgag par mdzad do/ /ji ltar zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das don thams cad grub pa shākya'i rigs su skye ba yongs su bzhes nas/ de'i 'og tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya ba 'di gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i lung gi don de la mi rigs par thal/ lung des bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gong rol du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas shākya'i rigs su skye ba bzhes par bstan pa'i phyir zhes pa'o/ /de bzhin du rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen zhes bya bas ni rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i sras don thams cad grub pa dka' thub mdzad pa yan chad byang chub sems dpa' rang rgyud pa yin la/ de nas yid kyi lus 'og min du sangs rgyas nas/ de nas sprul pa po 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul ston pa'o zhes 'dod do/ /de'ang yang dag pa ma yin te/ mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das 'di bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sngon du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas shākya'i rigs su skye ba ston par mdzad do zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /de bas na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i thog mar sangs rgyas nas/ sprul pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ni phyis bskal pa bzang po 'di la 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul ston pa yin no zhes bya ba 'di theg pa chen po'i slob dpon dbyig gnyen dang /

zla ba grags pa dang / kun dga' snying po dang / skal ldan grags pa la sogs pa phal che ba'ang bzhed la/ kho bo cag gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyang bzhed pa yin no zhes gsungs pa'i gzhan lugs dgag pa ni yo ga ba shākya bshes gnyen gyi lugs dgag pa yin la/ rang lugs gzhag pa ni theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos 'khrul pa med pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig par ston pa'o/ /'dus pa'i gzhung rnams kyi dgongs pa ni de nyid bsdus pa dang / rgya cher rol pa ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ nai rāñja ra'i 'gram du byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pa mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs pa las/ sangs rgyas thams cad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bstan nas bslangs te mngon par byang chub pa'i thabs bstan pas sangs rgya bar gsungs pa'i don drangs don du 'grel pa ste/ dgongs gzhi ni sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i gong rol du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya ba'i tshe sngags kyi lam nyams su blangs pas sangs rgya ba la dgongs/ dgos pa ni shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'dir gdul bya rnams gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed pa'i ched yin te/ dkyil chog las/ sngags kyi sbyor ba mnyam med pas/ /drag po chen po bdud kyi sde/ /stobs chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /shākya seṅge mchog la sogs/ /'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas kyang / /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /spro ba bskyed pa sngon nyams su blangs pas kyang 'grub bo snyam na/ de ni ma yin te/ sngon nyams su blangs pa ni zhing 'di'i gdul byas mi rtogs la/ ston pa 'di'i rten la tshul bstan pa ni zhing 'di'i gdul byas rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /dngos la gnod byed ni sngar kun dga' snying pos drangs pa'i lung dang / sgron gsal du thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba'i lung drangs pa sogs/

theg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad las ston pa bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas zhing 'dir sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston par gsungs pa rnams kyis gnod do/ /grub chen kun dga' snying po'i dgongs pa'ang 'di nyid yin te/ sngar gyi dgag sgrub kyi 'gros las shes so/ /yo ga ba shākya bshes gnyen gyis/ rnam smin gyi lus nai rāñja ra'i 'gram du bzhag nas yid kyi lus byang chub kyi snying po 'og min du gshegs nas mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam pa bzhag pa las sangs rgyas rnams kyis bslangs par bshad pa ma gtogs slob dpon gzhan rnams kyis nai rāñja ra'i 'gram nyid du mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa las sangs rgyas rnams kyis bslangs nas ting nge 'dzin 'di rnam dag ma yin pas phyi'i mngon par byang chub pa'am/ nang gi mngon par byang chub pa bstan pas byang chub kyi snying po byang chub shing drung du sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa kho nar bshad de/ dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no/ /slob dpon ārayade was phyi'i mngon par byang chub pa mdo sde las gsungs pa'i 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur dang / yo ga nas gsungs pa'i mngon par byang chub pa lnga la byas nas/ nang gi mngon par byang chub pa 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul pa la bshad/ klu sgrub kyi dngos slob shākya bshes gnyen dang / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs gnyis kyis/ phyi nang gnyis kyi dbye ba ma bshad kyang nai rāñja ra'i 'gram du mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin las langs nas thams cad stong pa 'od gsal lam/ zab gsal gnyis med bstan pas/ nam phyed kyi dus su snang mched thob gsum thim pa'i rim gyis sems dben mngon du byas nas skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su sgyu ma lta bu'i skur langs te/ byang chub kyi shing drung du gshegs nas srod la bdud btul/

tho rangs 'od gsal dang zung 'jug gi sku mngon du byas par bzhed par gsal lo/ /tshul bstan pa la ni snga phyi gang yang 'gal ba med de/ gdul bya de dang de'i ngor snang tshul tha dad pa tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam gzhag rim par/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan nas 'dzam bu'i gling du babs te mngal du 'jug tshul gsungs pa'i mthar/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad mi'i bdag nyid kyi srid par bzhugs te/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos grub kyi go 'phang brnyes pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa'ang 'dus pa'i slob dpon gzhan rnams dang dgongs pa gcig ste/ tshul ston pa kho na la dgongs so/ /phyis kyi bla ma dag 'di'i don 'dus pa'i lam la brten nas sangs rgya ba'i rten yin na mi'i rten yin pas khyab par 'dod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' don grub 'dus pa'i lam la brten nas gsar du sangs rgya dgos pa rnams ni snga mas kyang khegs shing / gzhan du'ang bkag zin to/ /mdor na bye brag tu smra ba dang / yo ga ba shākya bshes gnyen ma gtogs longs spyod rdzogs skur 'dod pa thams cad ston pa 'og min du longs skur sangs rgyas zin nas/ spyir mdzad pa dpag tu med pa dang / bye brag mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong gi theg pa thun mong ba'i ngor mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang / rdo rje theg pas 'dul ba'i gdul bya'i ngor sngags kyi lam gyis sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa mthun no// //dpag med bskal pa'i dus nas sangs rgyas kyang / /zhing 'dir mngon par byang chub mdzad pa nyid/ /ston pa'i tshul la grangs nges rnam 'byed pa'i/ /dge bas 'gro kun byang chub myur thob shog /mngon par byang chub pa ston pa'i tshul drang don dang nges don rab tu phye ba'i rim pa 'di ni rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa rje btsun kun dga' bzang po la sogs pa'i yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa shākya'i dge slong bsod nams seṅges e waṃ chos ldan yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas su bris pa'o//

//dge'o// ༈ /gzhal yas khang gi chag tshad bzhugs so// ༈ /rang sems rnam dag byang chub phyogs/ /sum cu rtsa bdun phyi nang gi /rten 'brel gnad kyis thar pa che'i/ /grong khyer mchog tu shar la 'dud/ /snying po kye yi rdo rje yi/ /rten gyi dkyil 'khor rab gsal byed/ /gnad kyi zla zer las byung ba/ /tshigs su bcad par bsdebs pa ni/ /'og gzhi logs dang steng thog dang / /sgo dang rta babs lnga yis bsdus/ /'og la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /nyi ma pad+ma khor yug go /rdo rje'i lte ba gru bzhi'i rgyar/ /cha chen bcu gnyis dpangs su gcig /rwa rtse yan lag bzhi drug la/ gsum dang lnga ste cha chen gnyis/ /de 'og nyi ma pad lte yi/ /dbang gis ljang ser de yi tshad/ /de 'og pad+ma lte ba ni/ /rdo rje'i lte ba'i zur dang mnyam/ /pad 'dab cha phran gnyis kyis bskor/ /yan lag bzhi phyogs pad+ma med/ /khor yug dur khrod chos 'byung dang / /gur dang rdo rwa me ri ste/ /srung 'khor thun mong min bsgoms na/ /gur nang de dang bcas pa'o/ /logs la rtsig pa pha gu dang / /drwa phyed pa dang gdung leb ste/ /rtsig pa dbus nas cha chen bzhi/ /dor nas lnga pa'i dang po la/ /kha dog lnga sbrag cha phran gcig /dpangs su cha phran bcu drug go /de steng pha gu cha phran gcig /zheng du phyed dang gnyis yin te/ /ba gam tshul du rtsig pa las/ /phyi ru cha phran phyed 'phags pa'o/ /de steng drwa phyed sa la ni/ /dpangs su cha phran phyed pa yi/ /shing brtsegs 'og ma cha phran gcig /gong ma phyed phyed kyis lhag pa'i/ /bzhi brtsegs phyogs bzhir brgyad brgyad dang / /zur bzhir bzhi ste sum cu drug /de steng gdung leb cha phran gcig /dpangs su cha phran lnga chas 'gebs/ /phyi ngos shing brtsegs dag gi thad/ /chu srin mgo'am gzi pa tra'i/ /kha nas g.yas g.yon do shal gyi/ /rtse mo gnyis dang phyed pa yi/ /rtsa ba bzung nas pha gu la/ /'phyang ba'i tshul du gnas pa'o/

/rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi/ /stegs bu dmar po cha phran gnyis/ /phyogs bzhir lha mo bzhi bzhi yis/ /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pas gnas/ /steng thog ka ba shing brtsegs dang / /gdung dang thog phub rim pa gsum/ /ka ba sgo nang rtsa thig gi /g.yas g.yon cha phran lnga dor nas/ /drug pa'i gdung dang phrad mtshams su/ /dpangs su cha phran bcu drug ste/ /'og tu lha snam cha phran gcig /steng du shing brtsegs ka zhu la/ /cha phran gcig dang lnga cha ste/ /de steng gdung zlum cha phran gcig /de dang gdung leb mnyam pa'i steng / /thog phub 'og ma nang ngos zlum/ /phyi rol gru bzhi gdung leb las/ /phyi ru bya 'dab cha phran gnyis/ /de la 'og tu mda' yab dang / /steng du rin chen drwa mig gi /pu shu cha phran re re ste/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs kyis brgyan/ /thog phub bar ma gdung zlum gyi/ /steng du rtsig zlum phyogs mdog can/ /cha phran gsum te pha gu dang / /drwa phyed gdung leb de tshad mnyam/ /de steng rdo rje'i thal gdung bzhi/ /mig mangs ris su bres pa ni/ /cha phran gcig la lnga chas dman/ /re mig brgyad po zlum por phub/ /bya 'dab mda' yab pu shu rnams/ /snga ma'i tshad mnyam zlum po'o/ /thog phub gong ma re mig dbus/ /gdung steng rtsig pa gru bzhi ni/ /sngon po cha phran gsum pa'i steng / /pha gu sogs kyang de yi tshad/ /thog phub bya 'dab mda' yab sogs/ /ji ltar 'tshams pa tog gis spras/ /sgo ni phyogs bzhi'i rtsig pa'i dbus/ /cha chen gcig ste dpangs su gnyis/ /mdun du sgo khyud sgo yi tshad/ /de yi g.yas g.yon sgo 'gram la/ /cha phran gnyis te slar yang mdun/ /sgo logs nang du cha phran gnyis/ /phyi ru cha phran bzhi yin te/ /rtsig gdong gseg kar yod phyir ro/ /ya phub rtsig pa cha phran gcig /thams cad dpangs su cha phran dgu/ /de steng thog rnams mnyam por phub/ /sgo khyud phyi mthar sgo glegs gzhug

/rta babs ka ba sgo logs kyi/ /g.yas g.yon cha phran re dor nas/ /cha phran lnga pa gnyis gnyis te/ /phyi ma'i phyi mtha' stegs bu mnyam/ /nang ma'i nang ngos 'dod snam reg /de steng snam bu 'og ma ni/ /g.yas g.yon cha phran gsum gsum ste/ /gnyis pa gnyis dang gsum pa gcig /bzhi pa sgo logs rtsig gdong mnyam/ /g.yas g.yon skas kyi rim pa bzhin/ /mdun ngos thams cad mnyam po la/ /kha dog dbye bas so sor phye/ /de steng pad+ma chos 'khor gdugs/ /cha phran gcig dang gnyis dang gcig /g.yas g.yon ri dwags pho mo gnyis/ /shin tu 'byar min rgyang ring min/ /rta babs snam bu do shal nang / /pu shu'i kho ra khor yug tu/ /gos 'phan me tog phreng la sogs/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis mdzes par brgyan/ /nang ngos rgya dpangs mnyam pa ni/ /lus kyi dag pa nyid dang sbyar/ /gru bzhi rgya dpangs dpag tshad ni/ /lnga dang gsum par bya rgyud las/ /gsungs pa bzhib par brtsis pa ni/ /gser gdung man gyi nang ngos yin/ /nang gi ka ba brgyad po yang / /dpangs la cha phran bcu drug par/ /yo ga'i 'grel chen rnam gnyis las/ /gsungs pa thams cad rang shugs kyis/ /'grig pa'i rnam gzhag lhun grub 'di/ /lugs bzang 'di yi khyad chos yin/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed gshed dmar dang / /tshe dpag med dang rigs bsdus kyi/ /nang ma lnga sogs sgo rkyang gi /thog phub rim gsum kun la 'gre/ /kun rig la sogs sgo sbrag dang / /bde gsang la sogs sgo rkyang gi /thog phub rim lhag rnams la ni/ /khyad par cung zad bsnan par bya/ /gnad kyi zla zer las byung ba'i/ /zab don tshigs su bcad par ni/ /bsdebs pa mkhas 'dod ma yin gyi/ /blo gros gsar bu 'jug phyir yin/ /'di yi dge bas rang sems kyi/ /glo bur dri ma sbyangs nas ni/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /myur du mngon du 'gyur bar shog /dge'o// ༄༅/ /kun rig rigs bsdus bde mchog gsang 'dus sogs kyi blos slong gi sgo sbrag sogs kyi khyad par bzhugs//

༈ /snying gi dbus gnas rje btsun la/ /dwang ba'i yid kyis gus btud nas/ /slar yang sgo sbrag thog phub kyi/ /rim lhag tshul bzhin bshad par bya/ /kun rig sgo sbrag phyi ma yi/ /gser gyi gdung leb man chad la/ /cha phran bcu dgu lnga cha gcig /yod pa dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun/ /de nang lha snam cha chen gcig /dor nas dbus kyi cha drug la/ /shel gyi gar bu dpangs kyi tshad/ /cha chen bzhi pa nang ma'i bzhi/ /gar bu'i phyi ngos phyogs re na/ /ka ba gnyis gnyis mtshams su bzhi/ /bcu gnyis steng du ka zhu dang / /shing brtsegs gdung rnams gru bzhir gtang / /de dang phyi yi gdung leb gnyis/ /mnyam pa'i steng du thog phub ste/ /phyi ngos dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun/ /nang ngos nang ma'i rta babs kyi/ /thad rnams ma gtogs gar bu la/ /cha phran phyed dang gsum nyid kyis/ /non pa'i gru bzhi bya dgos te/ /blo yi snang bar char gyi chu/ /gong ma gong ma'i thog steng nas/ /'og ma'i steng babs thams cad kyang / /dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i 'dod snam gyi/ /'og ngos 'gro bar gsungs phyir ro/ /gar bu'i rgyar ni cha chen drug /yod pa'i mtha' la cha chen re/ /dor nas dbus kyi cha chen bzhi/ /dkyil 'khor nang ma'i nang gi tshad/ /de nang phyi ma'i cha chen la/ /nang ma'i cha chen gnyis yin kyang / /nang ma rang ngos brtsis pa'i tshe/ /grangs rnams spyi dang mthun par 'byung / /'di nas bzung ste nang ma yi/ /rang ngos cha rnams brtsi bya ste/ /thog phub rim gsum sgo rta babs/ /dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun par bya/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i tshab/ /gar bu yin phyir rwa rnams med/ /gar bu'i phyogs bzhir nang ma yi/ /sgo la 'dzegs pa'i them skas bya/ /rtsig pa'i nang du rang cha yis/ brtsis pa'i cha chen re dor nas/ /dbus kyi cha chen drug po la/ /dpangs su cha chen gcig steng du/ /'khor lo'i lte ba de dang mnyam/ /lte ba'i steng nas ka ba brgyad/

/cha phran dgu pa ka zhu sogs/ /gdung leb dang mnyam spyi dang mthun/ /phyi ma'i rwa rtse'i phyi rol nas/ /'jig rten khor yug zlum po dang / /rdo rwa 'od zer phreng bas bskor/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis ka'i 'og gzhi nas/ /phyur bu'i thog 'og man chad du/ /rang rang cha chen brgyad gnas pa/ /rtsig nang rgya dang mnyam pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor kun la sbyar bar bya/ /kha sbyor rgyud las gsungs pa yi/ /rigs bsdus sgo sbrag rim gsum la'ang / /thog phub 'og ma gar bur bcas/ /tshul 'di ji bzhin sbyar bya ste/ /'di yi dkyil 'khor nang ma yi/ /gser gyi gdung leb man chad kyi/ /tshul 'di dkyil 'khor bar mar sbyar/ /de nang lha snam cha phran gnyis/ /dor nas dbus kyi cha chen gsum/ /dpangs su cha chen gnyis 'phags pa/ /dkyil 'khor nang ma'i 'og gzhi yin/ /thog phub bar ma 'og dang mtshungs/ /nang ma'i thog phub spyi dang mtshungs/ /'di yi dkyil 'khor gsum char la'ang / /rang rang 'og gzhi nas bzung ste/ /phyur bu'i thog 'og man chad du/ /rang rang cha chen brgyad du gnas/ /de dang rang rang rtsig nang rgya/ /mnyam pa byung na 'grig pa yin// ༈ //bde mchog 'khor lo'i pho brang la/ /gser gyi gdung leb man chad kyi/ /rgya dpangs sgo dang rta babs dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi dang mthun/ /rtsig nang lha snam cha chen re/ /dor nas dbus kyi cha drug la/ /in+d+ra nī la'i sa gzhi yi/ /dpangs su cha phran phyed dang dgu/ /de steng sku 'khor lte ba'i dpangs/ /cha phran gnyis pa'i sked pa nas/ /rtsibs kyi dpangs la cha phran gcig /rtsibs mtha' 'og gzhi'i logs dang mnyam/ /rtsibs kyi rtse mor 'khor lo yi/ /rwa ba cha phran gnyis pa'i steng / /'khor lo'i ka ba cha phran lnga/ /ka zhu shing brtsegs gdung zlum rnams/ /cha phran gnyis dang lnga cha gcig /de dang phyi yi gdung leb gnyis/ /mnyam pa'i steng du thog phub ste/ /dam tshig 'khor lo'i thog phub yin/

/gdung zlum steng du rtsig pa dang / /pha gu gnyis la cha phran gcig /drwa phyed sa dang gdung leb la/ /cha phran gcig ste rwa ba nas/ /bzung ste gdung leb zlum po'i bar/ /sku yi 'khor lo'i logs yin te/ /gsung 'khor rtsibs kyi rtse mor ni/ /rwa ba nas bzung gdung zlum bar/ /snga ma'i tshad bzhin gnas pa dang / /mnyam pa'i steng du thog phub ste/ /'di ni sku 'khor thog yin phyir/ /'khor lo nyid kyis mtshan pa'o/ /de nyid rigs pas gsung 'khor te/ /khyad par pad+mas mtshan pa'o/ /de yi rigs pas thugs 'khor te/ /khyad par rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /de yi rigs pas bde chen gyi/ /'khor lo yin te khyad par ni/ /gri gug gis mtshan 'khor lo yi/ /tshab tu pad+ma 'dab brgyad do/ /rtsibs dang pad 'dab rnams kyi rgyar/ /cha phran gnyis par mnyam pa ste/ /lte ba rim bzhin de tshad kyis/ /chung ba yin te rtsibs kyi rtse/ /'og ma'i lte ba dang mnyam phyir/ /'og ma'i lte bar gong ma yi/ /ka steng cha phran phyed dang gnyis/ /rtsibs kyi bar mtshams brgyad du bya/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i gdung zlum steng / /rtsig pa nas bzung gdung leb bar/ /cha phran gnyis te de steng du/ /thal gdung bzhi la cha phran gcig /phyur bu'i tshad la cha chen gcig /spyi dang mthun te 'og gzhi nas/ /phyur bu'i thog 'og bar dag dang / /rtsig nang rgya dang mnyam pa yin// ༈ //gsang ba 'dus pa rigs gsum la/ /gser gyi gdung leb man chad kyi/ /rgya dpangs dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun/ /'phags pa'i lugs la klu byang gis/ /sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad cha ste/ /sgo khyud kyang ni de yi tshad/ /'gram dang logs kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs dgongs pa sgo yi dpangs/ /cha chen gsum dang rgyar ni gcig /sgo khyud 'gram logs de bzhin no/ /de yang nang ngos brtsis pa yis/ /bri byar ya phub med par 'dod/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba yi/ /phyi ngos ka rten btsugs nas ni/

/de steng rta babs ka ba gnyis/ /rta babs snam bu bcu gcig sbyar/ /rtsig nang lha snam cha chen re/ /dor nas dbus kyi cha drug la/ /dpangs su cha chen gcig 'phags pa'i/ /phyi ngos ka ba bcu gnyis sogs/ /thog phub 'og ma kun rig bzhin/ /gdung steng rtsig pa pha gu la/ /cha phran phyed gnyis drwa phyed dang / /gdung leb la yang de bzhin no/ /lha snam nang ma'i phyogs re nas/ /cha chen re dor dbus kyi gzhi/ /dpangs su cha chen gcig 'phags pa'i/ /steng du 'od zer phreng ba dang / /bcas pa'i rdo rwa zlum po ni/ /ka rten brgyad dang bcas pa'i dpangs/ /cha chen gcig ste de steng du/ /ka brgyad dpangs la cha chen gnyis/ /ka zhu shing brtsegs gdung zlum la/ /cha phran gnyis dang lnga cha gcig /de dang sngar gyi gdung leb steng / /thog phub phyi ngos gru bzhi'o/ /gdung zlum steng du rtsig pa nas/ /gdung leb bar du cha phran lnga/ /de steng thal gdung lnga cha gcig /dman pa'i cha phran gcig pa'o/ /de steng phyur bu cha chen gcig /lhag ma'i thog phub bya 'dab dang / /mda' yab pu shu dar 'phan sogs/ /dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun pa'o/ /tshul 'di dpyod ldan don gnyer gyis/ /tshul bzhin bskul nas sngar bstan pa'i/ /tshul lugs bzang po'i kha skong du/ /tshul gnas bsod nams seṅges sbyar// //dge'o// ༈ //'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi/ /dge ba gang dang gang thob pa/ /des ni skye bo thams cad kyis/ /bde gshegs shes rab myur thob shog /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /dge ba 'di yis dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen mdzod/ /bla med mchog gi bstan pa ni/ /dar rgyas yun du 'bar gyur gcig /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
